jcr_content.jcr:title: i-Chips IP00C382 - Image Processing Chip
jcr_content.jcr:description: The i-Chips IP00C382 is an advanced image processing chip designed for warping and edge-blending applications. Contact us for more info about this product.
jcr_content.keywords: IP00C382, i-Chips, De-Interlacer, Scaler, Warping, Edge blending, 4K, WQXGA, Image Processing, Distortion Correction, Image Stabilization, Image Quality, Keystone Correction, Pin Cushion Correction, RGB Common Distortion Correction, Image Correction, Uniformity Correction, Mirror/Flip Image, OSD, Gamma Correction, Error Diffusion, Brightness Adjustment, Contrast Adjustment, 256 Colors, High Color OSD, Image Stabilizer

textwithimage_1.text:
The i-Chips IP00C382 is a powerful warping and edge-blending solution designed to revolutionize visual processing. With its impressive 666Mpixel/sec signal processing capability, this all-in-one image processing chip is perfect for a wide range of applications.

Featuring support for 4K resolution at 60Hz input/output, including additional formats like WQXGA at 120Hz, the IP00C382 delivers stunning visuals with seamless performance. Its embedded warp table generator enables real-time image processing, allowing for precise distortion correction such as H and V keystone correction and pin-cushion correction.

text_1.text:
The advanced edge-blending technology enhances image quality and provides white peaking support, resulting in exceptional visual performance and captivating products. Whether you need to correct camera shakes or create immersive visual experiences, the IP00C382 image processing chip is the ideal choice.

With compatibility across various i-Chips products and the support of the innovative Warping API, this solution unlocks new possibilities for HV-Keystone, Pincushion, and Center shift cascade features.

Additionally, the IP00C382 image processing chip boasts impressive features such as distortion correction, image correction, image quality control, and a versatile OSD (On-Screen Display) system. Its compact size and flexible power supply options make it a convenient and reliable choice for your visual processing needs.

Unlock the power of i-Chips technology with the IP00C382 and experience unmatched performance in warping, edge blending, and image processing.

Input

  • 30-bit RGB / 30-bit YUV4:4:4 / 20-bit YUV4:2:2
  • @V-by-One® HS 4Gbps, 8 lane 1-port

Output

  • 30-bit RGB / 30-bit YUV4:4:4 / 20-bit YUV4:2:2
  • @V-by-One® HS 4Gbps, 8-lane 1-port

Input & Output Image Size

  • Horizontal sync signal 16,384 pixels (max)
  • Horizontal image active area 4,096 pixels (max)

External Memory

  • DDR3-SDRAM 32bit PC1600 (4G/2G/1G x16) x2

External/Internal Sync

  • Output sync signal is available only with internal sync signal

Input/Output Sync/Asynchronous Behavior

  • Frame rate conversion with frame tear protection
  • External force synchronization
  • Genlock

Distortion Correction Mode

  • RGB common distortion correction mode

Distortion Correction Method

  • Coordinate correction look up table

Embedded Warp Table Generator

  • Keystone correction and pin cushion correction
  • Load from external CPU or external serial flash

Distortion Correction Amount

  • Up to 45 degrees (horizontal/vertical)
  • Vertical shrink ratio is about x0.6 to 0.7 (about 50% of IP00C381)

Image Correction

  • Edge-blending (RGB independent gamma correction, white peaking supported)
  • Uniformity correction
  • Mirror/flip image

Image Quality Control

  • 16-bit color gamma correction tables (7LUT available)
  • Error diffusion, brightness, and contrast adjustment

Bit Map OSD

  • 256 colors/High color OSD (64K colors)
  • Embedded font engine (65536 words)
  • Blinking and semi-transparent (4 colors OSD)
  • 90-degree rotation, OSD scroll

Bitmap Transfer from External Serial Flash

CPU Interface

  • 4-wire serial

Serial Flash Interface

  • 2G-bit x 1 (max)

Power Supply

  • 3.3V/1.5V/1.1V

Package

  • 388-pin Plastic BGA (0.8mm pitch), 19mm x 19mm
